**If this issue affects you, please react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your feedback helps us prioritize which bugs to investigate and address first.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-14732)

This issue reports `st.switch_page` navigating to a blank page instead of the target page, with the URL not updating. The same author previously reported this in #14709, which was closed as cannot-reproduce. This new issue includes full reproducible code.

**Root cause analysis:** The user's entrypoint (`project.py`) uses third-party components (`EncryptedCookieManager` from `streamlit_cookies_manager_ext` and `streamlit_js_eval`) that can call `st.stop()` or trigger `st.rerun()` **before** `st.navigation()` runs. Critically, the code checks `if "cookie_manager" not in st.session_state` but only ever sets `st.session_state["cookies"]` — so the key `"cookie_manager"` is never stored. This means a new `EncryptedCookieManager` is created on every rerun, and `cookies.ready()` likely returns `False` on the first render (since the component requires a browser round-trip), triggering `st.stop()` before `st.navigation()` executes. When `st.switch_page` triggers a rerun, `st.navigation()` never runs, so no navigation message is sent to the frontend, resulting in a blank page.

This appears to be a **user code issue** (session state key mismatch) rather than a Streamlit framework bug. However, it does highlight a usability concern: when `st.stop()` is called before `st.navigation()` during a page-switch rerun, the result is a silent blank page with no error feedback.

### Related Issues

- [#14709](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/14709) — Same author, same problem (`st.switch_page` not working), closed as cannot-reproduce. This issue (#14732) is a re-filing with more detailed code.
- [#9009](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9009) — `st.switch_page` does not function within a `try/except` block. Related pattern where execution flow control (`st.switch_page` uses a `RerunException` internally) conflicts with user code patterns.
- [#10756](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/10756) — Custom components unmount and reload on `switch_page`. Related issue where third-party custom components interact poorly with page navigation.

The suggested probable reasons are not True.

The provided code reproduces the exact same problem.

Note: The navigation works perfectly when selecting the page from st.navigation but it doesn't work with st.switch_page.
